brief:
Priests Against Genocide held a shroud inscribed with the names of 300 children killed during ceasefires in Gaza and the occupied West Bank, according to Al Jazeera English. The group used the symbolic display to commemorate children who died during periods when fighting was supposed to have halted.

The action marked a form of protest against the deaths of Palestinian children during conflict-related events in the territory.
dek: Priests Against Genocide hold shroud with names of 300 children killed in 'ceasefires' in Gaza, the occupied West Bank…
title: Priests Against Genocide displays shroud bearing names of slain Gaza children
